input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for username password system authentication handler, trigger logout, i user id obtain. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with not bind exception functionality, so that I can accomplish my not bind exception-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with bind functionality, so that I can accomplish my bind-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
